title: The Exiled Prophet
logline: A hunted religious leader hiding in an asteroid field needs a pilot to smuggle out their final teachings before their radical pursuers find them.

roles.description: A former cartel boss who found religion and is now hunted for their pacifist teachings.
Young, naive, utterly devoted to the prophet's words.
A hollowed-out asteroid shielded from long-range scans.
A small group of followers trying to organize.

public_situation: Rumors are spreading that the legendary {role:exiled_prophet} has returned to the sector to preach a radical message of peace.
private_truth: The prophet is actually dying of engine radiation poisoning and just wants to ensure their disciple survives.

beats.public_change: A scrambled broadcast from the debris field calls for a discrete courier.

missions.reason: The disciple asks the pilot to navigate the dense debris and verify the hideout's location.
missions.private_fact: The disciple is testing if the pilot can be trusted not to sell them out.

beats.public_change: Bounty hunters begin sweeping the sector for the prophet.

missions.reason: The prophet needs the pilot to deliver specialized medical supplies to the hideout.
missions.private_fact: The supplies aren't for the prophet; they are fake death certificates for the disciple.

beats.public_change: The hideout's shielding fails, exposing their position.

missions.reason: The disciple asks the pilot to scan the hideout's wreckage to prove they died in the shield collapse.
missions.private_fact: The scan will falsely confirm their deaths, allowing them to escape.

player_choice.prompt: The prophet gives the pilot their final data drive. The pilot can deliver the teachings to the public, or sell the location to the bounty hunters.

options.label: Broadcast the teachings across the system

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the data drive.
resolutions.summary: The pacifist teachings ignite a movement. The prophet dies peacefully, and the disciple escapes to start a new life.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broadcast the last words of the great prophet before they passed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the coordinates or abandons the missions.
resolutions.summary: Bounty hunters raid the hideout. The prophet and the disciple are both captured and handed over to the authorities.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot safely relocates the prophet without broadcasting.
resolutions.summary: The prophet escapes to another system. The teachings remain a secret, but the disciple lives to learn another day.

loose_threads.detail: The bounty on the prophet was anonymously paid out of an account registered to a defunct charity.
The hideout's shielding didn't just fail; it received a localized override command from a nearby relay.

radio_hooks: Bounty on {role:exiled_prophet} doubled by unknown benefactor.
Unregistered transmissions detected near dense debris fields.

voice_direction.exiled_prophet: Weak, raspy, but entirely at peace. Speaks without fear.
voice_direction.loyal_disciple: Nervous, overly eager to please, recites scripture when stressed.
